ontology.name: Schema.org — Event
ontology.description: Events, venues, performers, and offers — a subset of Schema.org's vocabulary for describing events, ticket sales, and scheduling.

entityTypes.name: Event
entityTypes.description: A happening at a specific time and place — concert, conference, sports match, etc.

entityTypes.name: Place
entityTypes.description: A venue or location where an event takes place

entityTypes.name: Person
entityTypes.description: A performer, organizer, or attendee of an event

entityTypes.name: Organization
entityTypes.description: A company or group that sponsors or organizes events

entityTypes.name: Offer
entityTypes.description: A ticket or admission offer with price and availability

relationships.name: location
relationships.description: The venue where the event takes place

relationships.name: performer
relationships.description: A person performing at the event

relationships.name: organizer
relationships.description: The organization that hosts or sponsors the event

relationships.name: offers
relationships.description: Ticket or admission offers available for the event
